property_families.app_catalog: Product(name, price, stock, brand, category, ...) and Review(rating, content, helpful_count, created_at)
property_families.legacy_graph: Product(ProductName, UnitPrice, UnitsInStock, ...) and Review(Rating, ReviewText, ReviewDate, ...)

generation_cases.question: 华为Sound X现在卖多少钱，还有多少库存？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.name = '华为Sound X' RETURN p.price AS price, p.stock AS stock

generation_cases.question: 把小米品牌的商品名称、价格和库存列出来。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.brand = '小米' RETURN p.name AS product, p.price AS price, p.stock AS stock ORDER BY product

generation_cases.question: 有哪些应用商品的价格在200元到1000元之间？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.price >= 200 AND p.price <= 1000 RETURN p.name AS product, p.price AS price ORDER BY price, product

generation_cases.question: 查一下库存不超过35件的应用商品。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.stock <= 35 RETURN p.name AS product, p.stock AS stock ORDER BY stock, product

generation_cases.question: 博世智能冰箱Lite的图谱商品单价和库存分别是多少？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.ProductName = '博世 智能冰箱 Lite' RETURN toFloat(p.UnitPrice) AS unit_price, toInteger(p.UnitsInStock) AS stock

generation_cases.question: 按名称列出系统里的全部商品类别。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Category) RETURN c.CategoryName AS category ORDER BY category

generation_cases.question: 中国供应商中哪些联系人的职位是销售经理？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.Country = '中国' AND s.ContactTitle = '销售经理' RETURN s.CompanyName AS supplier, s.ContactName AS contact ORDER BY supplier

generation_cases.question: 列出新疆维吾尔自治区客户的公司名称和所在城市。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE c.Region = '新疆维吾尔自治区' RETURN c.CompanyName AS customer, c.City AS city ORDER BY customer

generation_cases.question: 2020年以后入职的员工是谁，担任什么职位？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (e:Employee) WHERE e.HireDate >= '2020-01-01' RETURN e.LastName + e.FirstName AS employee, e.Title AS title ORDER BY employee

generation_cases.question: 德邦物流的联系电话是什么？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (s:Shipper) WHERE s.CompanyName = '德邦物流' RETURN s.Phone AS phone

generation_cases.question: 查询79号订单的下单日期、收货城市和运费。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.orderId = '79' RETURN o.OrderDate AS order_date, o.ShipCity AS city, toFloat(o.Freight) AS freight

generation_cases.question: 应用商品评价里有哪些五星评价？返回商品名和评价内容。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (r:Review)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) WHERE r.rating = 5 RETURN p.name AS product, r.content AS review ORDER BY product

generation_cases.question: 应用商品中价格最高的前5款是什么？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.price IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name AS product, p.price AS price ORDER BY price DESC, product LIMIT 5

generation_cases.question: 统计每个品牌应用商品的平均售价和商品数。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.brand IS NOT NULL RETURN p.brand AS brand, round(avg(p.price), 2) AS avg_price, count(p) AS product_count ORDER BY brand

generation_cases.question: 应用商品按category字段分组后，各类别有多少款？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.category IS NOT NULL RETURN p.category AS category, count(p) AS product_count ORDER BY product_count DESC, category

generation_cases.question: 图关系中属于智能开关类别的商品有哪些，单价多少？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(c:Category) WHERE c.CategoryName = '智能开关' RETURN p.ProductName AS product, toFloat(p.UnitPrice) AS unit_price ORDER BY unit_price DESC

generation_cases.question: 苹果智能家庭供应了哪些图谱商品？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:SUPPLIED_BY]->(s:Supplier) WHERE s.CompanyName = '苹果智能家庭' RETURN p.ProductName AS product ORDER BY product

generation_cases.question: 找出下单数至少6单的客户，并按订单数降序排列。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH c, count(o) AS order_count WHERE order_count >= 6 RETURN c.CompanyName AS customer, order_count ORDER BY order_count DESC, customer

generation_cases.question: 每位员工处理了多少订单？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (e:Employee)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order) RETURN e.LastName + e.FirstName AS employee, count(o) AS order_count ORDER BY order_count DESC, employee

generation_cases.question: 按物流公司汇总配送订单数量。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_VIA]->(s:Shipper) RETURN s.CompanyName AS shipper, count(o) AS order_count ORDER BY order_count DESC, shipper

generation_cases.question: 哪些已发货订单是在要求日期之前发出的？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL AND o.ShippedDate < o.RequiredDate RETURN o.orderId AS order_id ORDER BY o.ShippedDate LIMIT 20

generation_cases.question: 列出尚未发货的订单编号和客户名称。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NULL RETURN o.orderId AS order_id, o.CustomerName AS customer ORDER BY toInteger(order_id)

generation_cases.question: 按月份统计订单量，并按月份排序。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WITH substring(o.OrderDate, 0, 7) AS month, count(o) AS order_count RETURN month, order_count ORDER BY month

generation_cases.question: 客户写下的图谱评价中，每款商品的平均评分是多少？至少要有2条评价。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (:Customer)-[:WROTE]->(r:Review)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) WHERE r.Rating IS NOT NULL WITH p, avg(toFloat(r.Rating)) AS avg_rating, count(r) AS review_count WHERE review_count >= 2 RETURN p.ProductName AS product, round(avg_rating, 2) AS avg_rating ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, product

generation_cases.question: 应用评价中各商品的平均星级和评价数是多少？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (r:Review)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) WHERE r.rating IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name AS product, round(avg(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, count(r) AS review_count ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, product

generation_cases.question: 最有帮助的5条应用评价分别属于什么商品？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (r:Review)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) WHERE r.helpful_count IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name AS product, r.helpful_count AS helpful_count, r.content AS review ORDER BY helpful_count DESC LIMIT 5

generation_cases.question: 按收货城市统计订单数量，取前10个城市。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o.ShipCity AS city, count(o) AS order_count ORDER BY order_count DESC, city LIMIT 10

generation_cases.question: 运费最高的5个订单是哪几个？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o.orderId AS order_id, toFloat(o.Freight) AS freight ORDER BY freight DESC LIMIT 5

generation_cases.question: 哪些客户目前一笔订单都没有？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE NOT (c)-[:PLACED]->(:Order) RETURN c.CompanyName AS customer ORDER BY customer

generation_cases.question: 哪些类别在图关系里还没有关联任何商品？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Category) WHERE NOT (:Product)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(c) RETURN c.CategoryName AS category ORDER BY category

generation_cases.question: 按照订单明细计算每款图谱商品的销售额，返回前5名。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WITH p, sum(toFloat(line.UnitPrice) * toInteger(line.Quantity) * (1 - toFloat(line.Discount))) AS revenue RETURN p.ProductName AS product, round(revenue, 2) AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

generation_cases.question: 各图谱商品类别的销售额分别是多少？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(p:Product)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(c:Category) RETURN c.CategoryName AS category, round(sum(toFloat(line.UnitPrice) * toInteger(line.Quantity) * (1 - toFloat(line.Discount))), 2) AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC, category

generation_cases.question: 计算每位客户的累计消费金额，列出最高的5位。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(:Product) RETURN c.CompanyName AS customer, round(sum(toFloat(line.UnitPrice) * toInteger(line.Quantity) * (1 - toFloat(line.Discount))), 2) AS spend ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 5

generation_cases.question: 按供应商统计其商品带来的销售收入。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(p:Product)-[:SUPPLIED_BY]->(s:Supplier) RETURN s.CompanyName AS supplier, round(sum(toFloat(line.UnitPrice) * toInteger(line.Quantity) * (1 - toFloat(line.Discount))), 2) AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC, supplier

generation_cases.question: 每位员工处理订单的销售额和订单数是多少？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (e:Employee)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(:Product) RETURN e.LastName + e.FirstName AS employee, count(DISTINCT o) AS order_count, round(sum(toFloat(line.UnitPrice) * toInteger(line.Quantity) * (1 - toFloat(line.Discount))), 2) AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC

generation_cases.question: 哪些图谱商品经常出现在同一订单中？列出共同出现次数最多的5对。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p1:Product), (o)-[:CONTAINS]->(p2:Product) WHERE p1.productId < p2.productId RETURN p1.ProductName AS product_1, p2.ProductName AS product_2, count(DISTINCT o) AS together_count ORDER BY together_count DESC, product_1, product_2 LIMIT 5

generation_cases.question: 购买过华为智能生活所供商品的客户有哪些？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product)-[:SUPPLIED_BY]->(s:Supplier) WHERE s.CompanyName = '华为智能生活' RETURN DISTINCT c.CompanyName AS customer ORDER BY customer

generation_cases.question: 每位客户在各商品类别上的消费金额是多少？返回金额最高的10项。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (customer:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(p:Product)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(category:Category) RETURN customer.CompanyName AS customer, category.CategoryName AS category, round(sum(toFloat(line.UnitPrice) * toInteger(line.Quantity) * (1 - toFloat(line.Discount))), 2) AS spend ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 10

generation_cases.question: 按下单月份汇总销售收入。
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(:Product) WITH substring(o.OrderDate, 0, 7) AS month, sum(toFloat(line.UnitPrice) * toInteger(line.Quantity) * (1 - toFloat(line.Discount))) AS revenue RETURN month, round(revenue, 2) AS revenue ORDER BY month

generation_cases.question: 购买商品类别最丰富的前5位客户是谁？
generation_cases.reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(category:Category) RETURN c.CompanyName AS customer, count(DISTINCT category) AS category_count ORDER BY category_count DESC, customer LIMIT 5
